_comment: Known Irvine City Council meeting dates, in ISO form.
Why this file exists: the dashboard used to derive the next meeting from
a '2nd and 4th Tuesday' rule. The council's real calendar has exceptions -
summer recess, cancellations, special sessions - that no recurrence rule
can express, so the rule confidently displayed meetings that were not
happening. Actual dates are now the source of truth.
Granicus is preferred when it has them: once an agenda is posted, that
meeting appears under Upcoming Events on the ViewPublisher listing and is
merged with this list automatically. Agendas post roughly a week ahead, so
this file covers what is known earlier than that.
Anything not listed here and not yet on Granicus is simply unknown, and
the dashboard says so rather than guessing.
To add a date: append it in YYYY-MM-DD form and note where it came from.
Past dates are ignored, so old entries can be left or pruned freely.

meetings.source: Confirmed by CM office, recorded 2026-08-12. Council is in recess through the August and early-September meeting slots.
